name: psychology
description: Review a change in your plan and decide your next step, using context you choose. Non-clinical support.

interface.longDescription: Continue a goal, task, relationship question or diary note using context you choose. Review what changed and decide your next step. Use available Noesis tools to update records, with the required permissions and review. Noesis uses your self-declared age band. Ages 13-17 have basic tasks, goals and reminders with limited collection. Eligible adults can use the available features they authorize. Health, instruments, imports, research and sharing have separate requirements. Unknown age does not grant adult access. Unavailable under 13 or in the EU, EEA or UK. Your AI host's age rules apply. Not diagnosis or treatment.
defaultPrompt: My plan changed. Help me review my goal, current limits and next action using the context I choose.
My client asked for extra work. Help me compare the original agreement with the new request and draft a reply.
Help me turn this agreed next step into a Today task using the available account tools.
